description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Gate to the Afterlife triggers, causing you to return any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs, discard a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.
